note: Codes and official English labels taken verbatim from the downloaded Eurostat SDMX codelist ESTAT:NACE_R2_1(13.2), never from memory. `sdmx_id` is Eurostat's own code list identifier; `code` is the EC_CORPORATE_CODE (the human-facing NACE numeric code, e.g. 62.01). Kit domains for software products (crm, support, project-management, general-saas) are horizontal: the product itself classifies as J62/J582/K62/K63 (software publishing / computer programming / computing infrastructure), while the *customer's* industry is whatever NACE code fits their business - list both where relevant.
